title: Storied Paris department store BHV Marais seeks bankruptcy protection
summary: Paris department store BHV Marais, which courted controversy last year with a partnership with Asian fast-fashion giant Shein, said on Tuesday, October 28, that it had filed for bankruptcy protection to safeguard its operations and jobs. The bankruptcy procedure "is part of BHV's relaunch, not its failure," the company said, adding that the landmark store opposite Paris City Hall that employs 700 people will remain open.
